label: Established Ethics as First Philosophy in Totality and Infinity
description: Emmanuel Levinas formulated and introduced the concept of "The Face of the Other (L'Autrui)", which became a seminal contribution in ethics philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in ethics.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of Emmanuel Levinas's canonical writings.

label: Profoundly influenced Derrida's deconstructive ethics and hospitality
description: Jacques Derrida was fundamentally influenced by Emmanuel Levinas's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Emmanuel Levinas's perspective to Jacques Derrida's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis across history into the Contemporary & Post-Structural.
